assets/vo/s01-33d035f7.mp3: Here's how to build a Claude skill, in sixty seconds.
assets/vo/s01-60876b00.mp3: A skill is a set of instructions Claude picks up on its own, when your request needs it.
assets/vo/s01-e6fc5d94.mp3: Let's build one, step by step.
assets/vo/s02-94fb09f3.mp3: Say you want Claude to write your pull request descriptions, the same way every time.
assets/vo/s03-326239e7.mp3: Step one: in dot claude slash skills, make a folder named after the skill. P R description.
assets/vo/s04-432ad044.mp3: Step two: inside it, add one file: skill dot M D.
assets/vo/s04-6028eefd.mp3: At the top, a name, and a description of when to use it.
assets/vo/s04-cfa1e5cf.mp3: Below that, the instructions, in plain English: run git diff, then write three sections. What, why, and changes.
assets/vo/s05-7abd32da.mp3: Claude reads only each skill's name and description up front. When your request matches, it loads the full file and follows it.
assets/vo/s05-be282514.mp3: Same format, every time. Just keep the description specific, or Claude won't know when to use it.
